name: use-hover-dot-morph
title: Hover dot morph
description: Runs a dot animation while its parent card is hovered or focused.
usage: A dot picture that changes when its card is pointed at (CustomerLogoDots, PagesCover, GlyphMelt). Pass a lazy `load` that returns a player from `createDotMorphPlayer`.
avoid: A hover morph with no link

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
